messages:
Ellie: Weird morning alert: big puddle turned the Civic Center plaza into a temporary skating rink. BART detour announced. Anyone rerouting? :ocean:
Jon: On the 10 bus. Driver is taking the long way around due to a flooded underpass. ETA +20. My shoes are now waterlogged. :man_shrugging:
Priyanka: Left a pair of clean socks in the lobby (size 8). Labelled them "commute raid". Take them and leave a coffee emoji if you snagged them. :coffee:
Theo: Heading in from SoMa. Saw a small group performing a "raindance" (or maybe just trying to get a bus to show up). Cheerful chaos. :dancer:
Karen: If anyone needs a towel, there's one at concierge. Also, I'm two seats away from a very philosophical pigeon who refuses to move. :bird:
TransitBot: BART alert: https://bart.gov/alerts/214500 | Civic Center: temporary detour in effect due to plaza flooding. est_resume: 15-35 mins
```
service: BART_Richmond/Embarcadero
status: detour
cause: surface flooding
est_delay: 15-35 mins
```
Ellie: Thanks @TransitBot. Jon, if you want a sock swap, come by the lobby and grab Priyanka's pair. Also bonus: someone left a package of granola bars on the bench. :yum:
Jon: Claiming socks and the granola bar. Saving my dignity and my toes. :sneaker:
Priyanka: Tiny poll: should we add a "commuter emergency" shelf in the kitchen with socks, towels, umbrellas? React :+1: for yes, :dash: for no.
Theo: :+1: and also add a small sign that says "No Pigeons on the Towel" (kidding). :laughing:
Karen: Concierge says they're happy to host a small box if Facilities approves. I'll poke Facilities. :hammer_and_wrench:
Ellie: Update: I made it through the detour, sneakers sad but intact. If anyone needs a lift from Civic Center, ping me. Car has room for two and a very wet emergency playlist. :cd:
Jon: Thanks! Heading to lobby now. See you in a soggy minute.
Priyanka: Socks taken. Leaving a :coffee: as thanks. Good luck, commuters! :raised_hands:
